output.reason: The pipeline_planning stage is not atomic: it spans decoder operator semantics, stream/beat ordering, ready/valid liveness, buffer and branch/join contracts, template binding, numeric contracts, and memory/runtime handoff. SACG memory truth shows no active retry, backtrack, or contamination blockers, and the candidate artifact already contains checker evidence, so independent specialists can audit distinct cross-layer constraint surfaces in parallel before an evidence gate aggregates acceptance and repair boundaries.

handoff_rule.failure_route: Route failed operator, shape, or attention findings to pipeline_repair; do not allow evidence gate acceptance until targeted repair and checker rerun are planned.
handoff_rule.handoff_when: All assigned checker names have pass evidence or each failure is mapped to a violated constraint and repair boundary.
produces_for_downstream: accepted operator order and shape/attention contract findings
explicit note that symbolic latency is planning metadata only

subtasks.objective: Verify that the planned operator-stream pipeline preserves Qwen2 decoder order, residual paths, GQA attention semantics, tensor shapes, and stage boundaries without introducing free-form RTL obligations.

produces: SACG coverage notes for constraint.model.decoder and constraint.shape.model

decision_authority: May accept or reject model-shape and operator-order portions of the plan.
May require pipeline_repair for semantic, shape, attention, or residual-path violations.
May not waive checker-backed acceptance requirements.
role_assignment.mission: Audit the semantic correctness of the pipeline as a decoder-block implementation contract rather than as generated RTL.
out_of_scope: Do not change numeric policy or memory address layout.
Do not generate or edit RTL/Chisel.
Do not claim simulator, synthesis, timing, or board evidence.
primary_responsibilities: Check that stages follow rms_norm_1, self_attention, residual_add_1, rms_norm_2, mlp_gate_proj, mlp_up_proj, activation_mul, mlp_down_proj, residual_add_2 order.
Check residual skip edges and branch/join pairing keys against token/tile/lane/word semantics.
Check GQA attention contract values, including q heads, kv heads, group size, head_dim, causal flag, RoPE, and seq_len bound, against model configuration constraints.
Confirm tensor widths and seq_len are consistent across stages and stream edges.
Classify any mismatch as a SACG constraint violation with bounded repair scope.

subtasks.title: Audit decoder operator order and stage-shape contracts

handoff_rule.failure_route: Route stream, beat, branch/join, or liveness failures to pipeline_repair with the failing edge_id, buffer_id, or join node.
handoff_rule.handoff_when: Stream order, transfer counts, ready/valid flow control, and bounded FIFO contracts are either checker-accepted or precisely localized to a repair boundary.
produces_for_downstream: transfer count and AXI beat audit
repair boundary if deadlock or ordering risk is found

subtasks.objective: Verify stream_edges and data_edges mirror each other, transfer order and beat counts are coherent, branch/join contracts are liveness-safe under ready/valid backpressure, and all buffers are bounded template-backed FIFOs.

decision_authority: May accept or reject stream/beat/liveness portions of the pipeline plan.
May require a bounded pipeline_repair for specific edges, buffers, splitters, or joins.
May not alter model operator order or memory base address assignment.
role_assignment.mission: Audit the pipeline transport contract so later implementation can bind templates without hidden ordering or deadlock assumptions.
out_of_scope: Do not assign final DDR base addresses beyond checking handoff readiness.
Do not run real simulation or Vivado tools at this stage.
Do not redesign templates or invent unsupported flow-control primitives.
primary_responsibilities: Check that stream_edges mirror data_edges, including block_input, residual-skip, branch, join, and block_output boundary edges.
Check token/tile/lane/word transfer_order and full-beat policy on every edge.
Check transfer_count_bytes, element_bits, stream_beats_per_axi_beat, and axi_beats for consistency with tensor shape and 512-bit AXI assumptions.
Check ready_valid split policy, join policy, and FIFO depths for bounded backpressure behavior.
Classify symbolic latency as non-acceptance evidence and prevent it from being used as throughput or hardware proof.

subtasks.title: Audit ready/valid stream, beat, branch/join, buffer, and deadlock contracts

handoff_rule.failure_route: Route template coverage, numeric mismatch, or parameter-binding gaps to bounded_template_repair or Stage 4 parameter binding; do not let codegen consume unsupported bindings.
handoff_rule.handoff_when: All stage template_ids and numeric contracts are covered by input policy/library evidence, or gaps are declared as bounded planned repair items.
produces_for_downstream: per-stage template and numeric compatibility matrix
parameter-binding gaps for Stage 4 if any
explicit confirmation that free_form_rtl_generation remains false

subtasks.objective: Verify that every pipeline stage is bound to a trusted template with compatible numeric input/output/internal bit widths, accumulator policy, and parameter-binding readiness for later template-constrained code generation.

decision_authority: May accept or reject numeric/template portions of the plan.
May require bounded_template_repair when a stage lacks trusted template coverage or numeric policy compatibility.
May not claim timing/resource closure from symbolic latency or template existence alone.
role_assignment.mission: Protect the method boundary by ensuring the pipeline plan is template-constrained and numerically consistent before implementation handoff.
out_of_scope: Do not select a different model architecture.
Do not generate Chisel/RTL or run compile tools.
Do not promote resource estimates to synthesis evidence.
primary_responsibilities: Check every stage source/template_id against the trusted template library and Stage 2 template selection.
Check numeric_stream_policy against per-stage numeric_contract fields for activation, weight, scale, accumulator, rounding, and saturation expectations.
Check that 16-bit and 32-bit edge widths are intentional cross-layer contracts, not unbound implementation guesses.
Identify Stage 4 parameter bindings still required without treating them as current-stage failures when checker evidence passes.
Block unsupported free-form RTL generation claims.

subtasks.title: Audit numeric policy and trusted-template binding

handoff_rule.failure_route: Route current-stage memory/runtime contract failures to memory_runtime_repair; route missing later-stage evidence to verification plan obligations, not to current-stage risk if static planning checks pass.
handoff_rule.handoff_when: Memory/runtime handoff is checker-accepted as a plan, and any missing real tool evidence is explicitly deferred to later stages rather than claimed here.
produces_for_downstream: runtime command sequence and XDMA device contract verdict

subtasks.objective: Verify that the pipeline plan leaves coherent memory/runtime contracts for later address mapping, code generation, and board execution without claiming implementation or deployment evidence in the planning stage.

downstream_consumers: Stage 6+ verification and backend board stages

decision_authority: May accept or reject memory/runtime planning contracts.
May require memory_runtime_repair for inconsistent region sizes, alignment, AXI assumptions, or runtime sequence contracts.
May not finalize physical addresses or claim deployment evidence.
role_assignment.mission: Ensure memory and runtime contracts are coherent enough for downstream implementation while preserving the boundary between planning evidence and real board/tool evidence.
out_of_scope: Do not run board_runtime, Vivado, VCS, or Verilator tools in this stage.
Do not assign final physical addresses unless already supplied by an accepted memory-layout artifact.
Do not repair model, numeric, or stream contracts except by filing bounded findings.
primary_responsibilities: Check DDR4/AXI width, alignment, region sizes, and ping/pong/weight-buffer policy against board memory constraints.
Check runtime sequence length rule and target_seq_len consistency with transfer counts.
Check XDMA H2C/C2H device templates, control protocol, and command sequence against runtime board constraints.
Identify which obligations are deferred to Stage 5+ address assignment, code generation, real simulation, Vivado, and board runtime.
Prevent unsupported claims of bitstream, board pass, or timing closure from planning artifacts.

role_profile.professional_analogy: memory subsystem and board-runtime integration engineer

subtasks.title: Audit DDR, XDMA runtime, activation, and weight-buffer handoff contracts

handoff_rule.failure_route: If any required checker fails, emit bounded_repair_or_promotion_decision.json with target repair agent and violated SACG constraints; if evidence is missing, block promotion and require the named checker/tool evidence.
handoff_rule.handoff_when: All parallel_group=0 reports are present and either accepted by canonical checkers or mapped to bounded repair actions with no unsupported pass claims.
produces_for_downstream: promotion package for Stage 4 if accepted

subtasks.objective: Aggregate specialist reports, verify checker-backed acceptance for pipeline planning, block unsupported hardware-pass claims, and map any residual failure to bounded SACG repair actions.

decision_authority: May promote the pipeline plan to Stage 4 only if all required planning evidence is accepted.
May block promotion on checker failure, missing evidence, unsupported hardware claims, or human-boundary violations.
May not rewrite specialist findings or perform unbounded redesign.
role_assignment.mission: Act as the planning-stage evidence gate that closes cross-layer consistency only from checker-backed artifacts and bounded specialist findings.
out_of_scope: Do not perform generic brainstorming or paper-writing.
Do not run synthesis, implementation, board runtime, or functional simulation tools in this stage.
Do not waive SACG checker evidence or approve contamination-barrier bypasses.
primary_responsibilities: Aggregate all specialist outputs and the candidate checker_results into a single evidence ledger.
Confirm that pass evidence uses canonical checker names and that missing capabilities are marked as planned_tool.* or planned_checker.* rather than silently accepted.
Enforce stage_gate_policy: symbolic_first_order latency is planning metadata only, and Stage 3 must not claim hardware, timing, bitstream, or board pass evidence.
Map any failed or missing evidence to the smallest valid repair boundary: pipeline_repair, memory_runtime_repair, bounded_template_repair, or Stage 4 parameter binding obligation.
Produce the final promotion or block decision for downstream orchestration.

role_profile.professional_analogy: design verification lead and tape-in gatekeeper

subtasks.title: Aggregate checker evidence and enforce planning-stage acceptance boundary
